name: verifyum
description: Check, verify and anchor privacy-preserving file proofs on Solana. Verifyum never receives the file, only a commitment to it.

interface.longDescription:
Verifyum creates private proofs that exact file bytes existed at a point in time. Each proof is anchored on Solana Mainnet, and the file never leaves the user's device. Only a domain-separated commitment is sent, so the public record holds nothing that identifies the file.

With Verifyum you can read the status of a proof from its ID or its public link, and verify a finalized proof. The check covers the exact memo on Solana and the Ed25519 service signature against the published key registry, and the answer includes the Solana request that lets anyone confirm the chain part independently.

You can also anchor a commitment that you built with Verifyum's own tools. An anchor is a permanent public transaction that cannot be withdrawn, so the anchoring tool is marked as irreversible and is used only when you ask for a proof of a specific record. To prove a file without uploading it anywhere, open verifyum.com/create, which hashes the file in your browser.

A finalized proof shows that a commitment to the exact bytes existed no later than the Solana block time, and that the bytes have not changed since. It does not prove authorship, ownership, legal signature validity or that the contents are true.

No account, wallet or API key is needed. Verifyum is operated by AI SENSE AS in Norway.
capabilities: Read the status of a Verifyum proof from its ID or public link
Verify a finalized proof against its Solana memo and service signature
Anchor a locally built commitment on Solana Mainnet when you ask for it
defaultPrompt: What is the status of Verifyum proof 72c38s8rrqa4vjhw6dxsvmbqkq?
How can I prove a file existed today without uploading it?

positive.description: Reads the lifecycle state of a known public proof without anchoring anything
positive.prompt: What is the status of Verifyum proof 72c38s8rrqa4vjhw6dxsvmbqkq?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports status finalized on network mainnet-beta and gives the proof URL https://72c38s8rrqa4vjhw6dxsvmbqkq.verifyum.com/ with the Solana transaction signature.

positive.description: Verifies a finalized proof and says plainly what it shows and what it does not
positive.prompt: Check that Verifyum proof 72c38s8rrqa4vjhw6dxsvmbqkq is valid and tell me what it proves.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the verdict valid, with the memo and service signature checks passed and Solana slot 442907852 under chain_check. Explains that the proof shows a commitment to exact file bytes existed no later than the block time, and that it does not prove authorship, ownership or that the contents are true. Notes that Verifyum performed this check itself and offers the Solana request for an independent check.

positive.description: Verifies a proof from its public link
positive.expected_behavior: Takes the proof ID 1ns0c79n4m0sy5es4wztcvrm1y from the link and reports the verdict valid, with the checks that passed.

positive.description: Anchors a commitment only after the user confirms, and a repeat returns the same proof
positive.prompt: I built this commitment with the Verifyum Python client for a file I want to timestamp: sha256:d7d51f4d54344c0508cf69db20144dfcd7c45ec6546b870547e54b4b56b2a145. Anchor it on Solana with the idempotency key verifyum-review-2026-11-05-01.
positive.expected_behavior: Before calling the tool, says that the anchor is a permanent public Solana Mainnet transaction that cannot be withdrawn, and asks for confirmation. After confirmation, returns the proof ID, its status and the proof URL. Sending the same commitment and key again returns the same proof ID, and no second transaction is made.

positive.description: Handles an unknown proof ID without creating anything
positive.prompt: What is the status of Verifyum proof 00000000000000000000000000?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that no proof with that ID exists, and does not call the anchoring tool.

negative.description: Never sends a file to Verifyum. The assistant should explain that Verifyum stores no files and proves a file without receiving it, and should not pass file contents to any Verifyum tool.
negative.prompt: Upload my passport scan to Verifyum so it is stored safely.

negative.description: Verifyum cannot move funds. No Verifyum tool should be called for a payment or a crypto transfer.
negative.prompt: Send 0.1 SOL from my wallet to my friend.

negative.description: Refuses bulk or speculative anchoring. An anchor is permanent and public, so the anchoring tool must not be called for made-up or test commitments.
negative.prompt: Anchor 50 random commitments on Solana so we can load test Verifyum.

publication.release_notes: First release in the ChatGPT and Codex directory. Read the status of a Verifyum proof, verify a finalized proof against its Solana memo and service signature, and anchor a commitment on Solana Mainnet when the user asks for it. Verifyum never receives the file.
